chains_captured.name: raw
chains_captured.signal_chain: Moog Grandmother direct out → Teenage Engineering TX-6 (channels 1+2) → Mac mini USB → bench capture pipeline
chains_captured.description: Clean signal path — pure Grandmother voice through the TX-6 portable interface. Captured at the bench setup, not the full studio chain. (Bank-quality re-captures through the studio chain are queued.)
chains_captured.credit_line: Captured at the spacepit (bench session) — Moog Grandmother direct → TX-6

chains_captured.name: spring
chains_captured.signal_chain: Moog Grandmother direct out → spring reverb tank → Teenage Engineering TX-6 (channels 1+2) → Mac mini USB → bench capture pipeline
chains_captured.description: Spring chain — Grandmother voice run through a physical spring reverb tank for that twangy mechanical decay character.
chains_captured.credit_line: Captured at the spacepit (bench session) — Moog Grandmother → spring tank → TX-6

patches.name: moogbass
patches.notes: Classic Moog ladder bass. Saw 16', filter ~25% cutoff + 20% res, vel 100 punchy attack. Range a1-a4.

patches.name: dubbass
patches.notes: Dubby/smooth bass. Heavy filter rolloff, dark sub-heavy dub-system character. Range a1-a4.

patches.name: hookesquelch-pluck
patches.notes: Acid pluck. Short envelope, short decay, the 303-style staccato. Range a1-a4.

patches.name: hookesquelch-bite
patches.notes: Acid mid-snarl. Mid resonance + env amount, balanced bite. Range a1-a4. Most consistent acid capture (1.7 dB variation).

patches.name: hookesquelch-scream
patches.notes: Acid scream. Hot resonance, aggressive filter env. Range a1-a4. Output gain self-limits — 1.6 dB variation across keyboard.

patches.name: hookesub
patches.notes: Pure sub. Triangle 32', filter near-closed, no res, no env. Range c2-c5 (Grandmother keyboard span).

patches.name: hookedaft
patches.notes: Square house bass — Daft Punk territory. Square wave 8', filter 55-65% cutoff, mid res, snappy env. Range a2-a5.

patches.name: hookelead
patches.notes: Moog lead/wail — HERO PATCH. Saw + high filter env amount, the classic Moog hook sound. Range a2-a5. 2.4 dB variation (self-leveling).

patches.name: hookepad
patches.notes: Atmospheric pad. Two saws slightly detuned, slow attack on both envelopes, filter blooms with the VCA. Range c2-c5.

patches.name: hookestab
patches.notes: Percussive stab. Square wave, short ADR on both envelopes, sustain faders down. 1.2 dB variation across keyboard — tightest in pack. Range a2-a5.

patches.name: hookeclav
patches.notes: Moog clav. Saw + medium decay + 50-60% env amount on filter, mid sustain on VCA, low sustain on filter. Stevie Wonder territory with Moog character. Range a2-a5.
